description: FREE: Returns a free-tier API key (X-Api-Key) covering the standard endpoints for a daily quota — no payment, no account. Pass the key as the `api_key` argument to any paid tool to use it. Optional `email` argument is recorded. Also usable over plain HTTP: GET /v1/free-key.
name: get_free_api_key
title: FREE — mint a free-tier API key
